notes: NightShiftImd is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 SHIFT once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. Transfers have no fees or burns. There are no administrative roles, externally callable mint or burn functions, or application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
